name: searchd
description: Product-local resident search authority: crawl plan, schema, journals, FTS5/VANN, fusion, generations.

config.resume: boolean? — when true and compatibilityKey matches a lexical-ready guest, keep index/queues (warm restore)

configure.notes: Applies schemaSql as a multi-statement SQLite script and fails closed unless chunks_fts, chunk_vec, and the three FTS triggers exist. Index paths are fixed (see paths); refreshAfterMs is host-only.

crawl_step.notes: Guest owns queue/robots/fingerprints; calls host.org.main.search.fetch and .extract. Writes active or candidate DB based on writeCandidate. Auto-promotes a validated candidate (pages≥1, chunks≥1, not truncated).

embed_step.notes: Guest batches document texts through host.org.main.search.embed.batch; inserts VANN vectors into active index only

request.queryVector: number[]? — optional; guest embeds via host tool when semanticReady

query.notes: Always reads /var/searchd/index.db (active generation). RRF defaults are guest-hardcoded (k=60) unless overridden per request.

refresh.notes: Start candidate generation: wipe and rebuild /var/searchd/candidate.db with full schema postconditions; active index keeps serving queries

checkpoint.notes: Returns readiness status only — does not run SQLite WAL checkpoint/flush

input.userAgent: string? — ignored by visitor host; fixed AgentOSSearch/1.0
